CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)

   D. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.

8. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
